title: Add one-vCPU and low-RAM CI simulation
description: Add a reproducible constrained-host test or documented VPS-only gate that exercises startup and representative operations under one vCPU/low-RAM conditions.
acceptanceCriteria: The test constrains CPU/memory or uses an approved one-vCPU/low-RAM runner and records the actual limits
Startup, health, representative API operations, and shutdown complete without OOM or unbounded restart
The test is repeatable and does not alter the host’s permanent resource configuration
If CI cannot provide the constraint, the release gate remains a manual VPS task with a clear blocker

steps.details: Check CI/container/host tooling for CPU/memory limits and document the chosen method; do not pretend a normal runner is constrained.
Create a harness that applies a bounded workload/resource limit and asserts readiness/shutdown/health.
Use container flags, systemd/cgroup controls, or a documented VPS command according to the available capability; keep secrets disposable.
Run the simulation, capture resource evidence, and state whether real VPS verification remains required.

technicalNotes: Do not use a permanent host-wide `ulimit` or swap mutation in CI; isolate and clean up the test scope.
